description: Daily true-color satellite image of any area from NASA GIBS (MODIS Terra/Aqua or VIIRS, about 250 m per pixel, coastlines overlaid) as base64 JPEG. Useful to see clouds, smoke, snow, floods or fires on a given day. Params: bbox [min_lat, min_lon, max_lat, max_lon] or lat + lon + radius_km (5 to 500, default 50), date (YYYY-MM-DD, default yesterday), layer (modis_terra default, modis_aqua, viirs_snpp, viirs_noaa20), width (64 to 1024, default 512), height (default from aspect). Price: $0.008 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"lat":47.37,"lon":8.54,"radius_km":60,"width":512}.
name: satellite_image
title: Satellite Image (NASA)
